settings.section_content: On your first order only, we refund a pack your cat turns down, even if it is open. Just tell us which flavour, and keep the rest.
Send us a photo within 48 hours and we replace it free. Damaged wet food pouches do not need to be returned, please dispose of them safely.

• Opened packs, apart from the first-order exception above
  • Products without a readable batch code or label
  • Free samples, gifts and loyalty rewards
  • Requests raised after the 7-day window

1. Go to Account → Orders and tap “Return or replace”.
  2. Pick a reason and add a photo if we ask for one.
  3. We confirm within 24 hours and book a free pickup.

Refunds go back to the way you paid, UPI in 1 to 3 working days, cards and net banking in 5 to 7. Purrkins Credit is instant.

You can cancel free of charge any time before your order is dispatched. Subscriptions can be paused, skipped or cancelled up to 48 hours before the next billing date.

settings.heading: Returns & Exchanges Policy
settings.intro: At Pets of Paradise, we want you to be happy with your purchase. Returns are accepted only in the case of damaged or defective products.
